consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 10/19/1990 show at the ICC in Berlin was a standout performance, highlighted by an energetic 'Shakedown Street' and a solid setlist. The intimate venue and excellent sound quality contributed to a memorable experience, despite some minor performance quirks from Jerry.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 25 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the energy and sound quality, there were notable criticisms regarding Jerry's performance and some song execution.
